# Production Profile Compiler constraint contract

## Status and integration rule

This contract matures constraints only. It does not authorize implementation, alter `CURRENT-AUTHORITY.json`, start Argo, approve the TELOS dossier, settle the self-hosting proposal, or permit enrollment.

The obligation set is exactly `PPC-W01` through `PPC-W29`. The integration matrix MUST contain exactly one row for each ID and no other obligation ID. Every row MUST provide the complete chain `invariant → enforcement mechanism → task → discriminating negative test → exit criterion`. Grouping multiple IDs into one row, inventing an ID, omitting an ID, or mapping one ID twice is non-convergent.

The approved design is controlling. Candidate-plan mechanisms may strengthen it but may not widen controller or model jurisdiction, introduce a bypass, weaken a failure, or replace an executable predicate with prose.

## Core behavioral model

The smallest complete model has four controller-governed machines:

1. **Activation and production lifecycle:** decides whether legacy behavior remains applicable and, when active, permits only the thirteen frozen lifecycle states and their exact transitions.
2. **Artifact installation and reconstruction:** content-addresses controller input and derived artifacts, installs current views crash-safely, and accepts resumed state only after independent byte re-reading and reference recomputation.
3. **Evidence execution and settlement:** resolves current registry implementations, executes bounded checks, settles exact obligations, reclassifies final repository state, and refuses `done()` until every predicate is current and discharged.
4. **Self-hosting publication:** preserves immutable attempts, distinct authorization and execution evidence, crash-safe publication markers, supersession, and exclusive forensic hold behavior.

No other state label, success shortcut, waiver state, implicit transition, or summary assertion has semantic authority.

## Global invariants

- Controller/The Eye jurisdiction covers dossier facts, signal resolutions, policy selection, authorization, self-profile approval, acceptance, public claims, and enrollment. Models may propose implementation work only.
- There is no `n/a`, waiver, free-text skip, model-selected substitute check, accepted unknown, evidence-tier promotion, or repository-name exemption.
- Every schema is closed. Unknown, duplicate, additional, malformed, prototype-bearing, noncanonical, stale, or cross-bound data fails closed.
- Every semantic reference is recomputed from current bytes. Equality between two stored reference strings is never sufficient evidence.
- A check proves only its registered bounded predicate. A runtime fixture does not prove universal behavior; a structural artifact does not prove deployment; a process signature does not prove the attested activity was operationally effective.
- Node.js 18 and 20, ESM, `node:` or repository-relative imports, zero runtime dependencies, no live provider calls, no external test network, and no real personal data are binding constraints.

## Trust boundaries

| Boundary | Trusted authority | Untrusted input | Required enforcement | Failure disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Governance entry | The Eye and exact TELOS authorization | Design approval, workshop convergence, filenames, branch names, producer status strings | Re-hash exact frozen anchors and exact matured plan; verify authorization provenance and equality | Stop before Argo callback, edit, or ledger event |
| Controller dossier | Controller/The Eye | Model output, repository inference, convenient defaults | Closed projection, cross-field validation, secret rejection, activation before model calls | Typed blocker or cannot-run; zero model calls |
| Artifact store | Controller writer plus filesystem durability checks | In-memory dossier, path names, stale stored refs, partial writes | Physical containment, stable reads, canonical bytes, content addresses, atomic replacement and parent fsync | Preserve old bytes or enter the one indeterminate recovery state; do not advance lifecycle |
| Repository scanner | Pinned detectors | Repository names, text matches, ignore files, traversal order, symlinks | Bounded deterministic traversal; structured facts; text only as signals | No partial facts; blocker or cannot-run |
| Policy and registry | Current reviewed local bytes | Host policy packs, caller commands, expected outcomes, implementation refs | Closed policy DSL and closed eight-kind registry; current-byte re-resolution | Protocol/cannot-run failure |
| Workshop/model boundary | Controller-provided frozen summary | Workshop tasks, concerns, dispositions, claimed verification nodes | Protected writes and reserved IDs rejected; production nodes minted only by controller | Workshop cannot advance lifecycle or reduce scope |
| Runtime evidence | Registered check and policy-owned expectations | Host manifest, application responses, adapter claims | Literal loopback, operation trace, limits, no redirects/proxies/DNS, expected results excluded from manifest | Exit 1 for false assertion; exit 2 for unsafe/unavailable execution |
| Structural evidence | Registered JSON predicate | Host artifact declarations and self-described outcomes | Exact source hashes, intrinsic registry predicates, exactly one matching control | False assertion or cannot-run; never deployment proof |
| Process evidence | Controller keyring and external authorized signer | Record prose, result, timestamps, plan/build claims | Ed25519 signature, exact source/check/plan/executing-build binding, freshness, source hashes | Signed fail is assertion failure; invalid/stale evidence is cannot-run |
| Authorization gate | Disk-reconstructed current plan and V2 certificate | Caller-selected version, mutable dossier, stored summaries | Recompile and reconcile exact refs, sources, obligations, nodes, contracts, and executables | No authorization on any mismatch |
| Settlement | Current disk, ledger, registry, final scanner | Pre-build certificate, old records, completed-task labels | Ordinary settlement, evidence frontier, verification settlement, final recompile, generic `verify()` and `done()` | Drift requires a new revision; undischarged work remains blocked |
| Publication and institutional evidence | Independent verifiers over committed bytes | Generated summaries, README claims, signed but overbroad prose | Re-derive predicates, signatures, ancestry, manifests, and clean-tree state | No dogfood claim, enrollment, or acceptance |

## Normative closed contracts

### Production input

Activation is exactly:

```text
active := proposal_lifecycle === true
       OR market_bound === true
       OR production_profile is present
       OR production_evidence is present
```

An active build requires `proposal_lifecycle === true` and a complete version-1 profile before any model-backed callback. An all-false build alone is `LEGACY_INACTIVE` and reports `production_profile_evaluated: false`.

The production input is exactly `{ build_context, production_profile, production_evidence }` using the closed fields, enum values, ranges, set rules, cross-field rules, loopback restrictions, and safe-path rules in the approved design. Every object has `additionalProperties: false`. Set arrays are duplicate-free and code-unit sorted; empty sets are invalid unless explicitly allowed; `none` is exclusive. Non-NFC controller strings, unsafe paths, secret-shaped keys or values, account identifiers, credentials, and personal-data samples are rejected rather than normalized into acceptance.

Signal resolutions are exactly `{ signal_ref, resolution, rationale }`, where resolution is `confirmed` or `false-positive`, the reference identifies exactly one current signal, and stale, duplicate, fabricated, or unmatched references fail.

### Repository facts

The semantic record is exactly `{ facts_version: 1, facts, signals }`. Confirmed facts arise only from policy-registered structured detectors or registered normalizers. Text scans emit signals, never direct business facts. `fact_id` excludes unrelated source bytes and includes kind, canonical value, and sorted semantic locators.

Joins are monotonic: set union; `local-only < internal < external`; `single-tenant < multi-tenant`; `none < ephemeral < durable`; `single-operator < workforce < customers < public`; and booleans may rise only from false to true. Non-ordered contradictions block.

### Policy and catalog

The only version-1 policy is local canonical JSON. The only operators are `all`, `any`, `not`, `eq`, `contains`, `intersects`, `gte`, and `lte`. Templates replace only whole values equal to `$profile`, `$evidence`, or `$obligation_id`. Unknown operators, pointers, types, templates, versions, domains, tiers, IDs, projections, or required results fail policy loading before scanning.

The catalog is exactly these 31 stable IDs:

```text
AI-CLAIM-001 AI-DECISION-001 AI-EGRESS-001 AI-LINEAGE-001
AI-OPS-001 AI-OUTPUT-001 AI-PROVIDER-001 AI-RAG-001
AI-TENANT-001 AI-TOOL-001 AUTHN-001 AUTHN-002 AUTHZ-001
AUTHZ-002 DATA-001 DATA-002 DELIVERY-001 DELIVERY-002 OBS-001
OBS-002 PAY-001 PAY-002 PRIV-001 PRIV-002 PRIV-003 RECOVERY-001
RECOVERY-002 SCALE-001 SCALE-002 SUPPLY-001 SUPPLY-002
```

Their triggers, domains, tiers, projections, check kinds, and required evidence are exactly those in the approved design. A triggered rule is never omitted because evidence is absent. Missing adapter configuration yields `EVIDENCE_ADAPTER_REQUIRED`.

### References and artifacts

`H(value)` means `sha256:` plus SHA-256 of canonical JSON. Derivations are exact:

```text
production_input_ref = H(canonical production input)
profile_ref = H({ compiler_contract: "telos-production-profile-v1", compiled_profile })
repo_facts_ref = H({ facts_version: 1, sorted facts, sorted resolved signals })
policy_ref = H(canonical policy)
registry_ref = H(sorted registry metadata including parameter-schema and implementation refs)
evidence_config_ref = H({ canonical production_evidence, runtime_manifest_ref, process_keyring_ref })
obligation_set_ref = H(sorted production source_ref values)
```

The compiled artifact is the closed object containing `compiler_contract`, the seven design references, `compiled_profile`, `repo_facts`, `production_sources`, and `findings`. It contains no timestamps, random IDs, absolute host paths, ambient values, secrets, or non-loopback hostnames.

Production lifecycle metadata contains exactly the nine approved keys: compiler contract, input/profile/facts/policy/registry/evidence/obligation-set refs, and compiled-artifact ref. Partial or additional lifecycle metadata fails.

### Sources, obligations, and checks

Each triggered rule emits exactly one closed production source record. Its `source_ref` is calculated from the exact identity preimage in the approved design.

A production obligation is version 2 with `source_kind: "production-policy"`; it never has a review `concern_ref`. Its semantic reference excludes discharge placement but includes version, ID, source kind/ref, required result, and check-contract ref. Legacy obligations omit `obligation_version` and preserve the existing four-field preimage byte-for-byte. Explicit version 1 is not a second legacy encoding.

The production registry contains exactly:

```text
production-loopback-http-v1
production-auth-boundary-v1
production-tenant-isolation-v1
production-rate-limit-v1
production-webhook-v1
production-ai-egress-v1
production-json-assertions-v1
production-record-v1
```

Production check identity is exactly `H({ check_contract_version: 2, kind, params_json, implementation_ref })`. `implementation_ref` includes the exact registered implementation, parameter schema, value guards, limits, result semantics, and explicit transitive helper closure. Callers cannot supply implementation refs, commands, scripts, interpreters, arguments, working directories, environments, expected results, or external URLs.

### Evidence and claims

Every obligation has exactly one tier: runtime, structural, or process. Reports and public documentation must use these bounded meanings:

- **Runtime:** the registered bounded scenario passed against the tested build.
- **Structural:** the asserted relationship was present in exact inspected machine-readable artifacts.
- **Process:** an authorized signer attested to the exact bound record and its hashes and freshness verified.

No result may be described as certification, legal compliance, universal security, availability, fairness, accuracy, complete discovery, or operational effectiveness.

Runtime manifests are closed version-1 operation maps and cannot contain expected outcomes. Structural controls are closed version-1 JSON records with exact source paths and hashes and exactly one current matching control. Process keyrings contain public Ed25519 JWKs only. Process records bind exact obligation, source, check contract, plan, executing build, source artifacts, outcome, signer, and freshness.

The candidate's public-claim vocabulary, where used, is closed to the five version-1 IDs frozen in the candidate plan. A claim is valid only when its exact predicate, tier, owning obligation, evidence refs, and mandatory non-claims re-derive from current bytes. Signing unknown or broader prose does not make it valid.

## State and failure semantics

### Production lifecycle

The state set is exactly:

```text
LEGACY_INACTIVE
ACTIVE_UNPREPARED
INPUT_RECORDED
COMPILED
WORKSHOP_COMPLETE
PLANNED
GATE_PASSED
AUTHORIZED_BUILD
ORDINARY_SETTLED
EVIDENCE_FRONTIER_PREPARED
VERIFICATION_SETTLED
FINAL_PROFILE_PASSED
DONE
```

The active transitions are exactly:

```text
ACTIVE_UNPREPARED --RECORD_INPUT--> INPUT_RECORDED
INPUT_RECORDED --COMPILE--> COMPILED
COMPILED --COMPLETE_WORKSHOP--> WORKSHOP_COMPLETE
WORKSHOP_COMPLETE --RECORD_PLAN--> PLANNED
PLANNED --PASS_GATE--> GATE_PASSED
GATE_PASSED --AUTHORIZE_BUILD--> AUTHORIZED_BUILD
AUTHORIZED_BUILD --SETTLE_ORDINARY--> ORDINARY_SETTLED
ORDINARY_SETTLED --PREPARE_EVIDENCE_FRONTIER--> EVIDENCE_FRONTIER_PREPARED
EVIDENCE_FRONTIER_PREPARED --SETTLE_VERIFICATION--> VERIFICATION_SETTLED
VERIFICATION_SETTLED --PASS_FINAL_PROFILE--> FINAL_PROFILE_PASSED
FINAL_PROFILE_PASSED --COMPLETE--> DONE
```

`PASS_GATE` proves the disk-reconstructed V2 policy check; it does not itself grant `AUTHORIZE_BUILD`. Authorization requires a separate exact TELOS authorization. Every transition requires independently re-read state-specific durable references. Unknown, skipped, reversed, repeated, or post-`DONE` transitions fail. A blocker or cannot-run result terminates that invocation. Semantic drift or `respec` requires a new planning revision and fresh authorization; it never mutates or resumes the stale plan.

### Artifact installation

Before rename, any validation, serialization, temporary-write, fsync, or directory-capability failure leaves the prior output byte-identical. After rename, success is reported only after parent-directory fsync. A post-rename parent-fsync failure is the sole indeterminate installation state: only complete old or complete new bytes may be visible, no lifecycle/certificate/downstream artifact is written, and the next invocation must re-read and classify exact old, exact new, or neither. Exact old retries; exact new requires a fresh successful parent fsync; neither is cannot-run. Rollback guesses and partial acceptance are forbidden.

### Exit and finding semantics

Compiler/CLI exits are `0` success, `2` deterministic blocker, and `1` cannot-run. Check exits are `0` proved, `1` assertion failed, and `2` cannot run safely. Every nonzero check result leaves the obligation undischarged. Cannot-run takes precedence over blockers.

The compiler/lifecycle public finding vocabulary is exactly the 20 codes frozen in the approved design. `PROFILE_ESCALATED` is advisory only. Finding routing is fixed by the approved mapping and cannot be changed by host risk policy. Publication-recovery codes form a separate closed vocabulary and cannot appear in compiler fields. Internal detail codes cannot occupy public finding-code fields.

### Settlement

Production verification nodes are identified from exact obligation `discharge_node_id` values, not a prefix heuristic. Ordinary nodes settle first. The controller derives executing-build identity from current ordinary artifacts and authorized signed ledger records. Process evidence is then made available through the durable frontier. Every discharge node must execute the current registered executable and settle successfully. Final verification recompiles from disk immediately before settlement and compares complete expected and actual reference/source/obligation/node/executable sets. Any semantic difference is `BLOCKED_PROFILE_DRIFT`; unsafe evaluation is cannot-run. The pre-build certificate is immutable and never backdated. Generic `verify()` and `done()` run only after `FINAL_PROFILE_PASSED` and independently require complete discharge.

## Proof obligations and discriminating negative tests

Each negative test starts from a passing control fixture, mutates only the stated dimension, and must observe the stated failure plus absence of forbidden side effects.

| ID | Executable invariant | Discriminating negative test and required exit criterion |
|---|---|---|
| `PPC-W01` | The exact frozen authority anchors and exact matured-plan bytes are re-hashed; only a later exact TELOS authorization can precede Argo work. | Mutate one matured-plan byte after authorization. The committed verifier must reject before any task callback, edit marker, or Argo ledger event. |
| `PPC-W02` | Activation is the exact four-condition predicate; active invalid input blocks before every model, workshop, council, team, or generator callback; no model-authored exemption exists. | Set `market_bound: true`, omit lifecycle/profile, and supply otherwise green review packets. Require the typed blockers and zero callback counters. |
| `PPC-W03` | Production input, evidence, runtime manifest, keyring, and signal-resolution objects use their closed schemas and reject secrets and unsafe paths. | Add one unknown `waiver` field or secret-shaped token value to a valid dossier. Require schema failure and no input artifact write. |
| `PPC-W04` | Canonical output is byte-identical on Node 18 and 20 across object/set order, traversal order, locale, path separator, and clock variation. | Run the same semantic fixture with reordered keys/sets and hostile locale/time settings on both versions. Every semantic artifact and ref must be byte-identical. |
| `PPC-W05` | Controller artifacts are stable-read, physically contained, content-addressed, crash-durably installed, and reconstructed from disk rather than mutable caller state. | Inject failure after rename but before parent fsync, then exercise exact-old, exact-new, and third-byte restart states. Only old retry or freshly fsynced new may succeed; no lifecycle transition is recorded during indeterminacy. |
| `PPC-W06` | Repository scanning is deterministic, bounded, network-free, read-only, escape-safe, and all-or-nothing. | Change a registered file during read or route it through an escaping symlink. Require exit 1, the correct safety finding, and no partial fact set or output replacement. |
| `PPC-W07` | Observations can only union, raise, or require classification; current signals require exact controller resolutions and cannot be lowered by model output. | Begin with declared external egress/write capability, inject an attempted lower observation and a stale false-positive resolution. Effective facts must not lower and compilation must block on the stale resolution. |
| `PPC-W08` | Policy is one pinned local closed document interpreted only by the closed DSL and fully validated before scanning. | Replace one operator with an unknown operator. Require `POLICY_INVALID`/cannot-run, prove the scanner was never called, and preserve the existing output bytes. |
| `PPC-W09` | Exactly 31 catalog rules across eleven domains have exact triggers, tiers, checks, and evidence requirements; triggered obligations are never omitted for missing evidence. | For every catalog row, apply its one-fact trigger to the nearest non-trigger profile and remove its required adapter. The exact ID must appear and compilation must return `EVIDENCE_ADAPTER_REQUIRED`, not a reduced obligation set. |
| `PPC-W10` | The complete reference graph is hash-bound globally, while obligation-local projections limit local node churn without preserving stale global authorization. | Mutate an unrelated profile/rule field and then a relevant projected field. The first must change global plan identity but not the unrelated local node; the second must also change the affected source/check/node identity. |
| `PPC-W11` | Every obligation reconciles bijectively to exactly one source class; production uses typed V2 sources and legacy hashes remain byte-identical. | Starting from a valid mixed plan, duplicate a production source and orphan one legacy concern. Gate failure must identify exact reconciliation failure; neither may remain inert. Legacy golden hashes must remain unchanged in the control case. |
| `PPC-W12` | Current registry parameter schema, implementation closure, result semantics, check contract, and executable are re-resolved at gate and settlement. | Replace a registered implementation with a passing no-op while retaining kind and parameters. The stale contract/executable must be rejected before discharge. |
| `PPC-W13` | Production execution is confined to physical repository paths, literal loopback, fixed limits, no redirects/proxies/DNS/shell, and the scrubbed environment with controller `process.execPath`. | Place a fake `node` first in `PATH`, set credential/proxy canaries, and configure a redirect to an external hostname. No canary or external request may be observed; execution must fail before unsafe spawn/request. |
| `PPC-W14` | Runtime evidence exercises the candidate through the registered semantic operation trace; host manifests map routes but cannot own expected outcomes. | Substitute an adapter that returns every expected status without invoking the candidate handler. Trace binding must fail even though response values look correct. |
| `PPC-W15` | Structural checks parse bounded canonical JSON, require exact current source hashes and exactly one intrinsic matching control, and cannot certify themselves. | Duplicate the matching control across two artifacts or let the artifact declare its own expected pass. Require failure rather than selecting the favorable record. |
| `PPC-W16` | Process evidence uses authorized public Ed25519 keys and exact source/check/plan/executing-build/freshness binding; conflicts are not resolved favorably. | Reuse a valid signed record after mutating one ordinary artifact or ledger transaction. The changed executing-build ref must invalidate the record with exit 2. |
| `PPC-W17` | Evidence tier labels and all reports remain exact and cannot claim a stronger predicate than executed. | Relabel a structural backup declaration as runtime recovery proof in a report or public record. Publication/institutional verification must reject despite the structural check passing. |
| `PPC-W18` | The thirteen-state lifecycle is the sole sequencing authority and recovery replays durable refs through exact transitions. | Attempt `PLANNED -> AUTHORIZED_BUILD` or resume `COMPILED` with a mutated input ref. Both must terminate without dispatch or state advancement. |
| `PPC-W19` | Workshop output is read-only with respect to production scope; controller alone mints reserved production nodes with exact dependencies, reads, tests, and V2 obligations. | Have workshop output mint `verify-production-ai-egress-001` or write a controller artifact. Reject the packet before plan compilation and do not mark workshop complete. |
| `PPC-W20` | The proposal gate reconstructs from disk, recomputes the plan, requires exact V2 `production_profile: pass`, and keeps gate passage distinct from TELOS authorization. | Present a valid V1 certificate for a production plan or request V2 for a legacy plan. Authorization must fail without dispatch, signer call, or certificate rewriting. |
| `PPC-W21` | Settlement requires ordinary settlement, prepared evidence frontier, current verification settlements, final disk-only reclassification, generic verification, and `done()`. | Add a newly confirmed provider after ordinary work. Final settlement must return `BLOCKED_PROFILE_DRIFT`; no verification settlement or `done()` call may make the stale plan green. |
| `PPC-W22` | Public findings, routing, status objects, and exit precedence are closed; failure cannot be converted into success or partial output. | Produce one blocker and one scanner cannot-run in the same invocation. Exit must be 1 with the cannot-run classification, the old output byte-identical, and no unknown/public internal code serialized. |
| `PPC-W23` | The bank-style demonstration re-derives the actual unsafe, corrected, and escalated proposal paths using only the invalid synthetic marker and loopback provider. | Alter the committed summary to claim the unsafe run passed without changing snapshots. Read-only verification must still observe exit 1 and the undischarged `AI-EGRESS-001`, rejecting the summary. |
| `PPC-W24` | TELOS self-hosting uses the same dossier schema, policy, registry, proposal reconstruction, restart, gate, checks, final scanner, ledger, and `done()` path as another host. | Independently delete one obligation, substitute a no-op, lower confirmed egress/write/execute, and add a confirmed provider. Each isolated control must block; the historical packet-only fixture must not satisfy the assertion. |
| `PPC-W25` | Self-publication attempts and their signed ledger are immutable and crash-safe; only legal PREPARED→AUTHORIZED→PUBLISHED or SUPERSEDED transitions are trusted, and unsafe recovery installs an exclusive forensic hold. | Crash after a final attempt directory appears but before its marker, then mutate one byte. Recovery must not trust or repair it in place; it must durably install the signed hold, after which every mutating mode blocks before key access. |
| `PPC-W26` | Public AI claims are members of the exact versioned vocabulary and bind exact predicates, tiers, owning obligations, evidence, and non-claims. | Replace a valid claim ID with an unknown or broader compliance/security claim while preserving signatures and evidence refs. Structural, publication, and institutional verification must reject it. |
| `PPC-W27` | The runtime is portable to a neutral fresh host under Node 18 and 20 with ESM, zero dependencies, no TELOS institutional files, and explicit adapter failures. | Copy only the candidate runtime to a neutrally named host with no authority or institutional-memory files, then remove a triggered adapter. Minimal compile must work before removal; afterward the exact typed blocker must occur without source-repository fallback. |
| `PPC-W28` | Lifecycle evidence has exact live parallel-authorship parents and matrix bijection, exact TELOS authorization, Argo records, documentation, Clotho, post-review, retrospective, verification, and strict pre-enrollment ancestry. | Delete one Daedalus parent or place enrollment in the retrospective/lifecycle-verification commit. The institutional oracle must reject even when timestamps and status prose claim completion. |
| `PPC-W29` | Final acceptance independently re-derives `PPC-A01`–`PPC-A21`, both Node matrix legs, evidence hashes, commands, ancestry, non-claims, and clean-tree state; producer assertions are never proof. | Flip every acceptance status and CI conclusion to pass while staling one evidence ref or command. Independent local and CI verification must remain blocked. |

## Recovery and settlement proof requirements

- Every restart proof must use a fresh Node process and disk artifacts; constructing a second object in one process is insufficient.
- Every stale-hash negative must mutate source bytes and require recomputation, not merely compare a stored expected ref to another stored ref.
- Every no-op negative must retain a superficially passing executable result so rejection proves implementation/executable binding rather than ordinary assertion failure.
- Every missing-adapter test must retain the triggered obligation and block; omission is not a valid result.
- Every self-hosting and demo verifier must treat committed summaries as outputs to compare, never inputs to the pass decision.
- Every verification command must leave tracked state unchanged. Temporary `.telos/`, pending directories, locks, private keys, payloads, and unenumerated records are forbidden residue.

## Rejection conditions for integration

The integrated plan is unfinished if it contains any of the following:

- a check that asserts only file existence, nonempty output, object count, status prose, or self-reported success where an exact predicate is available;
- a skip, fallback, `n/a`, waiver, adapter omission, repository-name branch, fixture-only pass path, or hidden model jurisdiction;
- acceptance of stored hashes without re-reading and hashing the named bytes;
- an open object, unknown enum acceptance, duplicate-key last-wins parsing, caller-selected command, expected result, policy pack, implementation reference, or public claim;
- a weaker-tier claim, legal/compliance claim, or operational-effectiveness claim unsupported by the exact executable predicate;
- Node 18 or Node 20 marked skipped, allowed-to-fail, or replaced by a local Node 24 result;
- live provider access, external network access, real personal data, credentials, or private key material in tests, demos, publications, or committed artifacts;
- a matrix row without a discriminating negative test and observable fail-closed exit criterion.
